body.p: Bitaqtak is a card design application that allows users to create, edit, save and print cards.
The app does not require users to create an account. It does not collect or transmit personal information to our servers.
Users may select images from their devices to include in their card designs. These images are used locally within the app and are not uploaded to our servers.
Created designs may be saved locally on the user's device or in the device's image gallery.
We do not sell, share, or transmit users' personal information to third parties.
The app does not knowingly collect personal information from children.
For privacy questions, please contact the app developer through the app store listing.
